title: Flutter list items show wrong TextField contents after reorder
symptoms: Checkbox/text state sticks to index instead of item id
Reordering or filtering swaps visible state between rows
Animations look attached to the wrong child
cause: Widgets use Key based on list index (or no key), so Element/State reuse follows position rather than item identity.
solution: Assign ValueKey(item.id) (or ObjectKey) for stable identities; avoid UniqueKey in build for persistent rows.
